question: Which organisation was established in 1817 to promote Western education among Indians?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hindoo College**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hindoo College** was established in **1817** in **Kolkata**, India. It was an initiative to promote **Western education** among Indians during the early 19th century.
 
• The institution was founded by prominent Indian reformers such as **David Hare**, **Raja Ram Mohan Roy**, and others, in association with the British.
